Flu: Do you have a high fever?
Do you have a sore throat?
Common Cold: Do you have a runny or stuffy nose?
Do you have a mild cough?
Asthma: Do you experience shortness of breath?
Is there any wheezing sound when you breathe?
Do you feel tightness in your chest?
Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (Gerd): Do you feel a burning sensation in your chest (heartburn)?
Do you have a sour or bitter taste in your mouth?
Pneumonia: Do you have a cough that produces greenish or yellow mucus?
Are you experiencing chest pain when you breathe or cough?
Are you experiencing chills or shaking?
Food Allergy: Did symptoms appear shortly after eating?
Do you have any swelling of the lips, tongue, or throat?
Are you experiencing hives or an itchy rash?
Iron Deficiency Anemia: Do you feel unusually tired or weak?
Is your skin paler than usual?
Do you experience shortness of breath or dizziness?
Indigestion: Do you have pain or bloating in your upper abdomen?
Do you feel full quickly after starting a meal?
Are you experiencing any nausea or belching?
Anxiety: Do you feel restless, keyed up, or on edge?
Are you experiencing muscle tension or sleep disturbances?
Acute Sinusitis: Do you have pressure or pain in your forehead or cheeks?
Is your nasal discharge thick and yellow or green?
Have you lost your sense of smell?
Chronic Sinusitis: Have you had these symptoms for more than 12 weeks?
Do you have chronic nasal obstruction or congestion?
